title: Warm Kenyan Sweet Potato Casserole
description: A comforting and pillowy Kenyan dish featuring sweet potatoes and unflavored gelatin, finished with a flambe touch. This ovo-vegetarian-friendly casserole is perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pot, boil the sweet potatoes until tender, then mash and set aside.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the dissolved gelatin, melted butter, brown sugar, eggs, and heavy cream.
Add the gelatin mixture to the mashed sweet potatoes and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a wooden board and shape into a rectangular casserole.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Remove the casserole from the oven and flambe with rum.
Return the casserole to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the top is caramelized.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
